title: Fetal heart ultrasound (fetal echo)
what: The doctor looks closely at your unborn baby's heart with ultrasound: the chambers, valves, blood vessels, and rhythm.
why: If the screening ultrasound raised questions about the heart, if parents or other children have heart defects, if the mother has diabetes, after IVF, and with some medicines during pregnancy.
duration: usually 30 to 60 minutes; most often done at about 18 to 24 weeks
tell_doctor: Heart defects in you, your partner, or your children
Diabetes, thyroid conditions, or other illnesses
All the medicines you took during pregnancy

prepare.title: Preparation
prepare.text: Usually none. You can eat and drink as usual.

prepare.title: Time
prepare.text: The scan can take a while. Sometimes the baby lies in an awkward position. Do not plan anything important right after.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: Comfortable clothes that make it easy to uncover your belly.

steps: You lie on your back or slightly on your side
Gel is put on your belly
The doctor moves the probe to find a good view of the baby's heart
Sometimes you are asked to turn or walk a bit so the baby changes position
The doctor looks at the heart from different angles and with color blood flow
feel: Cool gel and light pressure from the probe
Lying on your back for a long time can be uncomfortable. Tell the doctor. You can lie on your side
after: The doctor usually tells you the result right away
If something is found, you will be referred to a pediatric cardiologist. Many heart problems can be treated well
Sometimes a repeat scan is planned later in pregnancy

faq.q: Is this ultrasound safe for the baby?
faq.a: Yes. Ultrasound has been used in pregnancy for many years. It does not use radiation.

faq.q: Why a separate heart scan if I had a screening?
faq.a: At the screening, the heart is checked briefly. Here the doctor studies it in detail and sees more.

reminders.text: Your baby's heart ultrasound is tomorrow. Bring your pregnancy record card and past ultrasounds. Plan about an hour for the visit.
